workflow-flow.title: From push to release
workflow-flow.alt: Two-lane flow: on every push and pull request ru-build runs generate-matrix, build and size-report and uploads fw-* artifacts; on a version tag ru-release-with-artifacts downloads those same artifacts and attaches them to a GitHub Release.
workflow-flow.description: Two lanes, each read left to right. The top lane runs on every push and pull request: the caller's esp32-examples-build-ci.yml calls ru-build, whose generate-matrix job checks out espidf-tools and turns app_config.yml into a matrix, whose build job runs once per matrix entry in the espressif/idf image, and whose size-report job comments a size table on pull requests. The build job uploads one fw-* artifact per entry. The bottom lane runs when a version tag is pushed: the caller's release.yml calls ru-release-with-artifacts, which downloads those artifacts for the tagged commit and attaches them to a GitHub Release, so nothing is rebuilt. Solid arrows mean "runs next", dashed arrows carry files. Job names are read from the workflow files.
